replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states no-login, never-expiring links; leaked link grants permanent full read."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Share link is sole secret per design; token enumeration harvests other users' documents."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design has upload endpoint and public viewer; active-content upload served to anonymous victims is concrete."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design has uploads and S3 storage with no authentication; cost/storage exhaustion attack is concrete."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design specifies S3 storage; direct object access bypassing link handler is a concrete attack."},{"id":"T6","keep":false,"reason":"Same enumeration attack and harvesting harm as T2.","duplicateOf":"T2"},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Anonymous viewing per design; lack of attribution after leak is a concrete distinct harm."}]}
